evidence: Added tools/Playnite.Fuzz, a deterministic bounded target over the four Playnite.Core.Serialization entry points. The tool verifies tests/fixtures/serialization-fuzz/manifest.sha256, mutates the committed seeds with a fixed-seed xorshift stream, runs structured malformed/deep-nesting/oversized probes, applies a 120 s wall-clock and 50M iteration budget, a 2 s per-case hang timeout and a 256 MiB managed-heap ceiling, and prints a single FUZZ COMPLETE marker only after a clean run. linux-ci runs the tool under a 150 s outer timeout and fails on a nonzero exit or a missing marker. Unit tests in tests/Playnite.Core.Tests/Serialization/FuzzTargetTests.cs prove the target has teeth: malformed and deep-nesting documents are rejected cleanly, and injected unhandled exceptions and hangs are classified as failures. Added byte copies of the v10 settings and extension-manifest goldens to the corpus with manifest and README provenance.
